reviews.title: A tad wonky but worth it.
reviews.comment: A tad wonky. The pump being on the rad makes it a tad wonky to mount but once I got it done works great. it runs very quiet and temps are stable. For the price it is a great value. I have had nothing but good service from darkflash products.
reviews.author: Michael 1953

reviews.title: Recommended not 100% sure about the long run but amazing so far
reviews.comment: Works great on my 5800xt constantly boosts to 4.9ghz and gets no hotter then 74 with a limited airflow case and manages to stay quiet while the RGB looks amazing for 42 bucks I don't think there's a 360m rad that could beat this.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Works pretty good for the price
reviews.comment: Works as advertised. A tad on the noisy side but the fans are quiet and move a nice amount of air. Runs a little on the warm side for an AIO other competing devices are about 5c cooler
reviews.author: Robert P.

reviews.comment: So good and cool everything down

reviews.title: 360MM AIO on a budget. 5 stars
reviews.comment: I caught this on a sale and it was a remarkable value. This cpu cooler is silent enough, cools well, and feels of very good quality. I appreciate the preinstalled daisychained fans and it looks very good in my opinion. Used it to cool an i7-10700K with ease. Easily recommended at $60-70 or less.
reviews.author: Elias Haddad
